subject: Evidence for key-rotation chaos drill & HSM attestation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fiorebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Sep 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence for key-rotation chaos drill & HSM attestation

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, FioreBank's SOC 2 auditor is asking for concrete evidence of our key rotation procedures and an HSM attestation package surrounding the tenant rotation "chaos drill" that we planned during onboarding. To keep this scoped and auditable, can you confirm whether the ask should include: 

- A signed HSM attestation (manufacturer/hosted HSM) covering firmware build and key-guard status,
- Rotation witness logs (timestamped CSV) for the last 90 days for the tenant keys involved,
- A short narrative describing the rotation process and operator separation controls, and
- Cryptographic artifacts (pre/post hash, KEK wrapping metadata) for one sample key rotation event.

Our proposed delivery plan (if that aligns):
1) Redwood provides a staged canary rotation in a non-production tenant and shares the signed witness log (CSV) and a sample KEK wrap/unwrap trace.
2) We upload the HSM attestation PDF to a secure share and provide the signing certificate chain.
3) We provide a one-page narrative and a short CSV mapping operator IDs to role IDs (redacted as needed).

If that scope works, can you confirm the required format for the rotation witness CSV and whether FioreBank needs timestamps in UTC or local (your preference)? We can aim to deliver the package by end-of-day Tuesday (2029-09-17).

I referenced the internal artifact names we will produce below in case you want to pre-stage retrieval: redwood-staging-rotation-witness.csv, hsm-attestation-20290914.pdf, kek-wrapping-sample-20290916.txt.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to nail formats.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fiorebank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, FioreBank Security <security@fiorebank.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Sep 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence for key-rotation chaos drill & HSM attestation

Marcus — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming FioreBank's SOC 2 team is looking for the items you listed. A few clarifying questions: 

1) CSV format: Our auditor prefers UTC timestamps (ISO 8601) and the following columns: event_time, key_id, operator_email, operation_type (rotate|rekey|evict), pre_hash, post_hash, wrap_algorithm, verifier_signature. Is that something you can produce?
2) Rotation scope: we only need one full rotation event (canary) from your staging run plus an index of prior rotations for provenance.
3) HSM attestation: it should include the HSM serial, firmware version, attestation timestamp, and the attesting authority. A signed PDF is ideal; we can receive the cert chain via secure link.

Also — will Redwood perform the rotation (actuate key material) in the tenant, or will you provide the logs and artifacts based on actions FioreBank initiates? We need to know the operator model for our internal control documentation.

If you can produce the CSV in UTC and attach the signed HSM attestation, we'll ingest that into our CAIQ/SIG response pack. The timeline you suggested (EOD Tue) works if you can confirm the CSV headers and provide the signed PDF by then.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Information Security Manager
FioreBank

Irene — can you prepare the attestation upload and the DocuSign attestation statement we discussed? Marcus — after Irene uploads the PDF and the signed CSV, I'll perform a quick checksum and add the manifest to the HubSpot record.

-Marissa
